2026-07-26 ~09:00Z — EIO ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (both machines) + home reposync leg CLOSED LIVE.

Home verdict: single-variable key removal (`plutil -remove LimitLoadToSessionType`) → raw bootstrap exit 0 first try. Helper running (PID 87328, state=running), rpc.sock real, serve immediately showed live watchbackend activity across the repo set, 5×60s samples steady, handshake counter still frozen at 1224, `reposync repo ls` clean. Local had confirmed the same one hour earlier (capt-hook.helper, pid 64693). Full observation matrix + fix direction filed as the daemonkit P1 (fleet backlog); 955ce63c cross-linked for the retry-misclassification half; 74be91d7 remains the staging sibling.

Home final table: synckitd 0.36.2 cutover complete/stable (serve PID 78035 since 19:13, counter flat at 1224 across every window); reposync 0.27.4 LIVE (v1 state, registered manifest, helper up); cc-notes 0.47.10; cc-pool 0.64.8 parked (user re-auth); cookiesync 0.17.0 untouched (0.27.3 available, cutover gated on the daemonkit fix); fusekit-holder unaffected. Evidence preserved: /tmp/helper-reposync-original.plist, state.json.v0.bak, state.json.flat-v0-20260726, manifests-pre-v0.36.2-20260726/. Two deliberately-open legs remain: cc-pool (user re-auth) and peer registration (box dark).

FRAGILITY CAVEAT ON RECORD: both machines run key-stripped interim plists; any `synckitd install` / `brew reinstall captain-hook` / `capt-hook helper install` regenerates the key and re-wedges. Box lane armed with the confirmed workaround for its next window. Speculative daemonkit fix (stop emitting the key for helper agents) building now in an isolated worktree; ship gated on the user's freeze-exception verdict.
